information:
From the ONS “Domestic gas consumption” indicator page (https://www.ons.gov.uk/explore-local-statistics/indicators/domestic-gas-consumption) it is noted that:

* The indicator shows **median domestic gas consumption (kWh)** for lower tier/local authorities (unitary authorities) from 2012‑13 to 2024‑25.  
* The data source is the **Department for Energy Security and Net Zero**.  
* The page provides links to download the full dataset in CSV/XLSX formats, e.g.  
  `https://www.ons.gov.uk/explore-local-statistics/api/v1/data.csv?indicator=domestic-gas-consumption&geo=ltla&time=2012-05-15,2024-05-15`  
  and similar links for specific years.

No actual numeric consumption values for Flintshire, County Durham, Bedford, North Lincolnshire, or Telford & Wrekin for 2012 and 2023 are presented on the page.

query: ONS domestic gas consumption Flintshire 2012 2023 CSV
information:
The information required (domestic gas consumption figures for 2012 and 2023 for each of Flintshire, County Durham, Bedford, North Lincolnshire and Telford & Wrekin) is contained in the local‑authority‑level dataset hosted on GOV.UK.  
The dataset is referenced and linked in the “Stacked gas consumption statistics data” page:

- **Dataset link** – `https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/69f9c094a40aa2232fede4af/gas_LA_stacked_2005-2024.csv`  
  *(Source: Stacked gas consumption statistics data – GOV.UK, “Gas consumption by Local Authority (LA), 2005 to 2024”)*

The CSV file includes a row for each local authority (including the five unitary authorities of interest) for each year from 2005 to 2024, with the domestic gas consumption figures (in kWh). The relevant years in that file are 2012 and 2023, and the values for the five authorities can be read directly from those rows.

information:

- Mean domestic gas consumption per meter  
  - 2012: 13,415 kWh a year  
  - 2023: 10,215 kWh a year  
  - Drop: 13,415 – 10,215 = 3,200 kWh

No data for County Durham, Bedford, North Lincolnshire or Telford & Wrekin were present in the provided page.
